game.desc: Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock is a rhythm game for Xbox 360. You will have to find and free the demigod of rock from the clutches of The Beast. The Beast is a supernatural and almost invincible being who has only one Achilles heel: music. To defeat him, the player will have to gather a group of legendary musicians around him in order to pass the various tests imposed by The Beast.
